friends_page.what_this_work_description:
How to invite friends so that they count towards you:

1. Post your invitation link in your profile

2. Click on the “Invite friends” button and select the dialog of the friends you want to invite

3. Post the story on Telegram with your invitation link (Telegram Premium owners only)

For a certain number of invited friends, you will receive an exclusive golden character, you can get acquainted with them in the “Friends” section

For each invited friend, you will receive a different reward in the form of gold, depending on whether he has Telegram Premium or not.

The second level of friends is when the friend you invited also invited another person. This person will be a second-level friend, for whom you will also receive a reward.

profile_page.user_agreement_content:
User Agreement

This Agreement regulates the terms of use of the Quest Animals Telegram application.

By using QUEST ANIMALS, you unconditionally agree to its terms and conditions.

1. General information

1.1. QUEST ANIMALS is a game in the Telegram messenger, with the possibility of virtual earnings of in-game currency, participation in game activities, and completing game tasks

1.2. The QUEST ANIMALS team are independent developers who create a gamified ecosystem that has nothing to do with the developers of the Telegram messenger.

2. Legal aspects of the game

2.1. The QUEST ANIMALS app is not:

- a financial service, an exchange, an investment platform;

- a collective investment service or an intermediary in transactions.

2.2. All actions in the app are game mechanics, not financial services.

3. Economics and in-game transactions

3.1. All items, characters, resources, currency, and tokens have in-game value and are not recognized as official assets

3.2. The user bears risks when exchanging, selling and using items, characters, resources, currency and tokens. The administration is not responsible for losses

3.3. The receipt, exchange and withdrawal of tokens depends on the current terms and conditions. Conditions are subject to change, all relevant withdrawal information is always listed in the game, in the "Bank" section

3.4. QUEST ANIMALS can change game mechanics, economy, course, etc. at any time

3.5. When making purchases using Telegram Stars, withdrawal can be frozen for 22 days from the date of the transaction.

3.6. In case of refund of the spent Telegram Stars in the game, the user is blocked without the right to restore

3.7. Withdrawal is subject to compliance with the agreement and the rules of fair play

4. Waiver of guarantees and profitability

4.1. Income or refund of Telegram Stars is not guaranteed. All expenses are voluntary, donations, and non-refundable.

4.2. The project is entertaining. Characters, task rewards, and tokens are bonuses for activity, not investment

4.3. The value of tokens, characters, resources, currency, and items may change due to administrative decisions or game events

5. User behavior and project security

5.1. It is forbidden to use auto-clicks, multiaccounts, bots, scripts, engage in fraud, abusing systems and any other automation of the gameplay. Any illegal action damages all honest players, the currency exchange rate and the commission on the P2P markets

5.2. In case of violations, QUEST ANIMALS may block your account, deprive you of items, characters, resources, experience, earnings, and any other value in the game. The measures taken in relation to the account depend on the degree of violation

5.3. In case of suspicion, it is possible to request user identification and temporarily block the account at the time of verification

6. Changes and updates to the agreement

6.1. QUEST ANIMALS may change the Agreement and the mechanics of the Application at any time

6.2. Continued use of the Quest Animals app means acceptance of updates, the user agreement, and any other changes to the mechanics of the game

6.3. We strongly recommend that you comply with this agreement and check for updates

faq_page.title: FAQ or Instructions for the game
faq_page.description: Here is all the important information about how to play, how to make money and how to upgrade!
faq_page.intro: Welcome to Quest Animals. This is P2E (play and earn) based on the TON blockchain with the richest and most diverse monetization at the moment.

toc.earn: 1. How to earn real money in Quest Animals

earn.title: 1. How to earn real money in Quest Animals
earn.intro: There are several ways to earn money in Quest Animals:

list.p2p_pets: Sale of exclusive or upgraded characters in the internal P2P Pet Market
list.friends_income: Income from active level 10 friends that you invited
list.weekly_reward: Weekly reward for a large number of invited friends
list.bank_exchange: Exchange of earned gold for TON in the "Bank" section at the current Quest Animals exchange rate
list.p2p_gold: Sale of gold to other players in the internal P2P currency Market
list.ton_pets: Purchase of characters giving TON per hour

earn.pet_price_text: Upgraded characters have a higher cost than level 1 characters. As you develop your character, their price increases.
earn.p2p_sell_text:
You can sell upgraded and exclusive characters on the internal P2P market of the game. To do this, you need to:
- On the main screen, click on the "Sell pet" button 
- Click on the "Sell" button
- In the ad creation section, select the character you want to sell, the currency you want to receive (gold or TON) and the amount for which you want to sell the characterAfter creating an ad, you need to wait for another player to buy it from you. Keep an eye on the prices on the character market and make the best offer to sell the character faster.
 All the earned TONS will be displayed on your balance, which you can withdraw to your TON wallet.
earn.friends_text: Every time you invite a person to the game through your referral link and they reach level 10, you get 0.05 TON. You can invite people through the "Friends" section
earn.weekly_text: Every week, the player who invited the most friends during the current week receives a TON reward on Monday.
earn.bank_text: Each player will be able to exchange earned gold in the game for TON at the current Quest Animals game rate
earn.p2p_gold_text: Each player will be able to sell earned gold to other players through the P2P Currency Market.
earn.ton_pets_text: There are characters in the game store who will earn you a TON per hour all the time
earn.summary: You have familiarized yourself with all the ways to earn real money in the game Quest Animals!

upgrade.title: 2. How to upgrade characters
upgrade.intro: There are several ways to upgrade characters in Quest Animals:

list.p2p_buy: Purchase of already upgraded characters on the P2P Market

upgrade.benefits: Leveling up characters is one of the main tasks in the game. Thanks to the upgraded characters, you get more gold and a TON per hour, you can sell the upgraded character and make a good profit in the form of a TON.
upgrade.missions_text: You can send your character on a mission through the "Map" section. On the map, you must select the area of the task, followed by the task itself. Each task provides gold and experience for the character. You can send from 1 to 3 characters to a task, as well as each task has requirements for completion, and the characters must meet these requirements.
upgrade.scrolls_text: Building scrolls can be purchased for gold or telegram stars in the internal game store
upgrade.p2p_text: Any player can start the game immediately with upgraded characters, it is enough to buy them from other players through the P2P Character Market.

guide.title: 3. Quick Start (Guide)
guide.intro: In order to start earning a lot quickly, you need to follow the guide written below:

steps.step1: You need to invite as many friends as possible at the very first moment. Referral characters are very strong, they are free and give a lot of gold at once when pumping, as well as each friend gives from 1000 gold.
steps.step2: With the accumulated gold, you need to buy scrolls of knowledge and upgrade the most profitable referral characters, as well as do not forget to send them on tasks
steps.step3: Start buying profitable characters in the store and P2P Character Market based on the balance of your gold and stars in telegram
steps.step4: Start selling upgraded characters in the P2P character market by earning the first TON and exchanging the accumulated gold for TON at the in-game exchange rate or selling to other players

guide.summary: Every aspect and element of the game is monetized and can be sold for a TON, from characters to earned gold.
